title: Why Was Madeira Wine Shipped Across the Ocean?
description: Because long, hot voyages made it better. Wine that crossed the tropics and came back was sold as vinho da roda, and estufagem now copies that heat on land.
heroAlt: Low vines on the terraces of Fajã dos Padres between a tall cliff and the sea
keywords: why was madeira wine shipped across the ocean
madeira wine and the american colonies

On the left, a low stone wall and beyond it the calm deep blue Atlantic. Warm side light, no people, true colours, realistic photo, no text.
